description: This file defines utility functions, classes, and procedures for bucketing and aggregating collective communication operations in PyTorch's FX graph-based transformation framework, specifically for optimizing distributed tensor operations such as all_gather, reduce_scatter, and all_reduce. It includes node analysis, bucket formation based on size limits, custom operation registration, and merging logic for collective operation graphs.
